data.summary: Ran E209: entrant share measurement on 5 federal IT PSC codes mirroring E208's NIH SBIR design. Found bimodal entry pattern (2 codes closed at 0%, 3 codes enterable at 27-31%). Kill gate G3 fired (ρ=+0.6669, p=0.1345, n=5 too small). Updated STATE.md and STATE-next-actions.md. All artifacts committed to EXPERIMENTS/E209-it-code-entrant-share/.
